what_happened.line: The Select Board voted unanimously to authorize litigation over an encroachment on the large town forest by the owners of 950 Chase Road.
The Conservation Commission chair described staffing shortages, and the board discussed its involvement in hiring a conservation agent; status updates were left to an offline talk.
The board scheduled a special town meeting for November 14 at 7 pm, with the warrant opening August 16 and closing September 18 at 5 pm.
The board approved six earth removal permit renewals, a toll fundraiser, a charity bike ride pass-through and Oktoberfest licenses.
Discussion of the FY24 goals was continued to next week, when the fifth member returns.

why_it_matters: The litigation concerns town forest land, so its outcome bears on what the town owns and may spend on legal action.
An understaffed Conservation Commission can slow permitting, land oversight and grant work, including a grant that needs a town match from the timber rights fund.
The special town meeting is a vote residents will be asked to take, and the warrant closes September 18.
watch_next: The Select Board's next meeting on August 22, when the FY24 goals are to be finalized.
The special town meeting on November 14 at 7 pm; the warrant closes September 18 at 5 pm.
